concurrency_protection.mechanism: SQLite atomic transaction + RLock thread serialization
concurrency_protection.tested_scenario: 5 concurrent threads attempting quota reservation on 2-attempt budget

crash_recovery.mechanism: Durable SQLite state committed before network dispatch
crash_recovery.tested_scenario: Simulated hard process termination after reservation, followed by store reconnect
crash_recovery.result: Quota reservation was durably preserved; token remained bound; no quota leak
